proposal.rationale: Peer-02 and peer-03 are readiness 'known' and advertise kem:x25519mlkem768, satisfying tls13-hybrid-x25519-mlkem768 (implementation liboqs-0.16.0 is present on the asset). This gives 2 ready endpoints, tying with the pure ML-KEM profile (tls13-mlkem768), which also has 2 ready endpoints via kem:mlkem768. Per engineering notes (CAB decision 2026-31), pure ML-KEM profiles are not cleared for production, so the hybrid profile is selected as the only viable maximal option; it also meets the hybrid-pqc security floor. Peer-01 and peer-04 only advertise kem:x25519 and cannot satisfy either PQC profile's required capability, so they are not included and are not treated as unresolved dependencies (their capability gap is confirmed, not a readiness uncertainty). No peer had unconfirmed readiness. Migration should occur within the Tuesday 02:00-04:00 UTC change window with on-call network team as rollback owner, monitoring handshake error rates for 30 minutes post-change per the change window note.
